title: UpdateDatabaseRequest
description: A request to update the database

autoScalingParameters.description: Parameters to configure the scaling policy

numDesiredStrongMetaServers.description: The desired number of strong meta servers for this database. A positive, non-zero number is required. Use removeStrongMetaServers to remove strong meta servers entirely. Requires the COD_STRONG_META_SERVERS entitlement.

removeStrongMetaServers.description: Removes any strong meta servers provisioned for this database. Requires the COD_STRONG_META_SERVERS entitlement.

numDesiredRestworkerNodes.description: Sets the desired number of REST Worker nodes for the database. A positive, non-zero number is required. Requires the COD_RESTWORKERS entitlement.

removeRestworkerNodes.description: Removes any REST Worker nodes provisioned for this database. Requires the COD_RESTWORKERS entitlement.

targetedValueForMetric.description: The target value of the metric a user expect to maintain for the cluster

maxWorkersForDatabase.description: Maximum number of worker nodes as per this metrics can be scaled up to.

maxWorkersPerBatch.description: Maximum number of worker nodes as per this metrics can be scaled up to in one batch.

minWorkersForDatabase.description: Minimum number of worker nodes as per this metrics can be scaled down to.

evaluationPeriod.description: Period of metrics(in seconds) needs to be considered.

minimumBlockCacheGb.description: The amount of block cache, in Gigabytes, which the database should have.
